translation.text:
<warning>Faded red vermilion woodblock print on yellowish paper; the 25 vertical columns of Classical Mongolian script, <term>Hudum Mongol bichig</term> <gloss>traditional vertical Mongolian script</gloss>, suffer from significant ink fading that obscures fine diacritical dots and medial tooth-strokes. The page contains two languages: Classical Mongolian in the main text and left marginal box, and Chinese in the right marginal box.</warning>
<meta>Folio 392 recto from the Kangxi imperial woodblock edition of the <term>Mongγol Ganjur</term> <gloss>Mongolian Kanjur, the translated canon of the Buddha's words</gloss>, Volume 77, corresponding to the eighteenth volume of the <term>Eldeb</term> <gloss>Miscellaneous Sūtras</gloss> section, <term>Zhūpǐn jīng</term> <gloss>Sūtras of Various Classes</gloss>. This <term>pothi</term> <gloss>elongated loose-leaf format modeled on Indian palm-leaf manuscripts</gloss> xylograph leaf is printed in red ink within a double-ruled rectangular frame with a small circular foliation mark at the upper left of the first column.</meta>

<margin>Miscellaneous <note>section of the Kanjur</note>, Eighteenth <note>Volume</note>, Upper <note>recto side of the folio</note>, Three Hundred Ninety-Two <note>original: "ᠡᠯᠳᠡᠪ ᠠᠷᠪᠠᠨ ᠨᠠᠢᠮᠠᠳᠤᠭᠠᠷ ᠳᠡᠭᠡᠳᠦ ᠭᠤᠷᠪᠠᠨ ᠵᠠᠭᠤᠨ ᠶᠢᠷᠡᠨ ᠬᠣᠶᠠᠷ"; transliteration: <term>eldeb arban naimatuγar degedü γurban jaγun yiren qoyar</term> <gloss>Miscellaneous, eighteenth, upper, three hundred ninety-two</gloss></note>.</margin>
<margin>Sūtras of Various Classes, Volume Eighteen, Upper <note>recto side of the folio</note>, Three Hundred Ninety-Two <note>original: "諸品經第十八卷上三百九十二"</note>.</margin>

<summary>Folio 392 recto from Volume 77 of the Kangxi imperial red-ink woodblock edition of the Mongolian Kanjur, belonging to the eighteenth volume of the Miscellaneous Sūtras section. The bilingual Mongolian and Chinese marginalia record the section title and folio number, while the 25 vertical columns of the main Classical Mongolian text remain untranscribed due to severe ink fading.</summary>
